description: Head-movement mini-game GA10: follow-the-dot game. Voice-guided, segmented motion only — 10 fixed dots, one at a time: a visual dot jumps discretely between up/down/left/right, never moves continuously, never traces a circle. Turn to the dot, hold 0.8 s for a hit, then return to center before the next dot appears. Dual-axis start calibration (look down, turn left) learns both signs. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: follow-dot
